verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API covering scraping, crawling, extraction, brand intelligence and an Answers endpoint for live-web research. Nothing in the evidence shows it generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside the product. The Answers and structured-extraction endpoints research or extract from public websites, which is a different capability and gets no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
